title: ATTP – THE No. 1 RECOGNISED BRAND IN MOLDOVA!
body_html:
ATTP (the National Association of Professional Table Tennis Players of the Republic of Moldova) is a leading organisation in the world of sport that passionately promotes a demanding discipline combining agility, concentration and competitive spirit.

Table tennis is not only a performance sport but also an accessible way to stay physically and mentally healthy, contributing to an active, balanced and united society.

Through its constant efforts, ATTP has become a model of excellence and commitment — which is why it had the honour of receiving the NOTORIUM 2025 Trophy for Recognised Brands (10th edition)
